:- module(main, []).
:- use_module(library(apply)).

main :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, L1),
    number_string(N, L1),
    read_scores(N, Scores),
    nth1(1, Scores, S1, Rest1),
    ( N >= 2 ->
        nth1(1, Rest1, S2, _)
    ; S2 = 0 ),
    DP1 is S1,
    DP2 is S1 + S2,
    ( N =:= 1 -> Ans = DP1
    ; N =:= 2 -> Ans = DP2
    ; nth1(3, Scores, S3, Rest3),
      nth1(2, Rest3, S4, Rest4),
      nth1(1, Rest4, S5, _),
      DP3 is max(DP1, 0 + S3) + S4,
      nth1(2, Scores, _, TailFrom2),
      nth1(3, Scores, _, TailFrom3),
      nth1(2, TailFrom3, _, TailFrom4),
      nth1(1, TailFrom4, S3b, _),
      nth1(1, TailFrom2, S2b, _),
      DP3b is max(DP1, S3b) + S2b,
      loop(N, 4, Scores, DP2, DP3b, Ans)
    ),
    format("~d~n", [Ans]).

read_scores(0, []) :- !.
read_scores(N, [S|T]) :-
    read_line_to_string(user_input, L),
    number_string(S, L),
    N1 is N - 1,
    read_scores(N1, T).

loop(N, I, Scores, DpPrev2, DpPrev1, Ans) :-
    ( I > N -> Ans = DpPrev1
    ; nth1(I, Scores, Si, _),
      I1 is I - 2,
      I2 is I - 3,
      nth1(I1, Scores, Sm2, _),
      nth1(I2, Scores, Sm3, _),
      Dp is max(DpPrev2, DpPrev1_3) + Si,
      DpPrev1_3 = DpPrev1 - Sm2 + Sm2,
      fail
    ).
